success_criterion: A GNN variant must improve BER, SER, and NMSE versus OAMP-DL across the complete locked regime, not merely one condition or one metric.
overall_criterion: A GNN variant must improve BER, SER, and NMSE versus OAMP-DL across all 135 test samples.

edge_threshold.reason: A fixed 1% relative threshold preserves meaningful channel couplings while removing numerical-scale entries; the fraction is registered before training and is not fitted to evaluation results.
